disposition.reason: The linked E000 IRQ edge bypassed the fixed facade. A new facade needs 3 bytes; the fixed block has 2.
disposition.budget: one WPLTO consumed; no successor product link or hardware run

scope: Second consecutive source-less IRQ in one raster-delimited episode

entry.rule: Only the already-terminal second-source-less absolute JMP may change; every returning IRQ path remains instruction-identical.

capture.rule: All witnesses are stored before SEI and before any call, branch, DMA, validation or loop. The prefix is straight-line and cannot fail.
capture.stack_rule: After the hardware IRQ frame and PHA/PHX/PHY/PHZ, TSX-relative $0106,X is interrupted PC low and $0107,X is interrupted PC high.

state_geometry.alias_rule: FF80, FF82, FF8A and FF8B are terminal aliases of event/break state; after capture no returning path exists.

display.rule: After capture and SEI, write ASCII F and 2 to screen cells 0 and 1 exclusively through c2_kernal_output_cell.
display.failure_priority: Memory capture is mandatory; visible output may be removed only by a new owner decision.

proof.nonfailure_delta_rule: The linked IRQ handler byte sequence must equal the predecessor except for the two-byte operand of the already-terminal absolute JMP.
mutations: call, branch, DMA or validation in capture prefix

hard_budget.terminal_rule: After the one run, attribute from the blackbox or park defstruct permanently for this era. No instrument revision or further diagnostic round.
